results.title: 타인의 userId/sessionId를 사용한 아바타 사칭 가능 여부(기존 전송)
results.level: real Supabase Realtime + real client RemotePlayerManager (unmodified transport)

observed.note: Supabase private-channel RLS authorizes the SOCKET (any authenticated account) but does not bind Presence key/meta to auth.uid(); validatePresence() trusts packet.userId/sessionId.

results.expected: presence/pose carrying another account's identity is rejected or never attributed to that account

results.title: 서버 인증 채팅 세션과 시각적 아바타의 안전한 대응

observed.note: The campus chat path derives the bubble's name from client-declared Presence, which a modified client sets freely; there is no server-authenticated chat session bound to the avatar on the campus transport.

results.expected: a speech bubble appears over an avatar only for a server-authenticated message from that account

results.title: 아바타 연결 미인증 시 피드 전용 안전 경로 동작
results.level: real PostgREST + real Supabase Realtime (SEC-01 lab inbox)
results.expected: server-authenticated envelope carries server-derived senderUserId/senderName usable for a feed line without trusting any client presence

results.title: 기존 전송 변경 없이 정상 말풍선 보존

observed.note: Stage A adds a separate server inbox path (SEC-01 lab RPC) and does not alter encodePose/buildPresence; a safe bubble needs a presence→chat-session binding that does not yet exist.

results.expected: pose/presence packet shapes identical to main; bubble preservation requires a new binding, not a transport change
